brief: Holds worker profiles, each with its own budget of slots, and runs or queues work against them so a busy kind never starves another.
detail: Work is sent to the profile it targets: the profile runs it at once when a slot is free, queues it when not, and sheds it when a bounded queue is full. That is load isolation. A heavy batch of one profile leaves the slots of every other profile alone. Profiles come from a facet catalog the pool owns (AddFacet, SeedAllFacets) or are declared ad hoc (AddProfile). The pool is in-process: work runs in the calling process and no worker process is started.
